name: Kiyozumi Hisora
source:
The protagonist of the story, he is a part-time worker. He is emotional and honest, but not always aware of his surroundings. He pursued the Man in Mourning Clothes and before he knew it, became lost in the world between the living and the dead.

[Source [URL=http://www.zombilica.com/games/nienomati/hisora.html] official website profile.[/URL]]
